## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Pine Script source
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Screenshot / visual evidence
- [ ] Case study
- [ ] Validation notes
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Validation

For Pine Script changes, include:

- TradingView compile result:
- Symbol:
- Timeframe:
- Visual check completed: Yes / No
- Screenshot updated if needed: Yes / No
- Live-bar / repainting implications reviewed: Yes / No
- Alerts reviewed if affected: Yes / No

## Evidence

Link screenshots, compiler output, test notes, or related issue(s).

## Limitations / risks

Document any unresolved edge cases, timing behavior, or validation limits.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No unsupported performance or profitability claims were added.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated when appropriate.
- [ ] Existing licensing and disclaimer language remains intact.
